title: Is It Possible? - Lehet...?
grammar: lehet + infinitive as a question and its answer; lehet with time, place and frequency

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can ask whether something is possible using Lehet + infinitive, and answer with Igen, lehet / Nem, nem lehet.
I can say when and where something is possible using time, place and frequency words with lehet.
